name: mahjong
description: Dev/build-time-only Node dependencies. No client-side JS ships from node_modules — the game bundle is esbuild-built from static/game/*.js (Dockerfile: jsbuild), and Tailwind's CSS build (assets/tailwind.src.css — deliberately outside static/, see its own header comment: a documented WhiteNoise+Tailwind gotcha, not a one-off workaround) is the one thing here that genuinely needs npm-style module resolution (@import "tailwindcss"), unlike esbuild/Biome which run fine via bare npx.
